title: ok3d settings
description: Every setting ok3d has. Helm checks settings.yaml against this before anything is deployed, and docs/settings.md is made from the descriptions here.

global.description: Set by Helm itself; not a setting.

settingsVersion.description: The version of the settings' layout. This release reads version 1.

cluster.description: The k3d cluster ok3d runs in.

name.description: The cluster's name: lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, starting with a letter, up to 32 characters.

k3sImage.description: The k3s image, pinned to a version (never latest). Kubernetes 1.37 or newer.

network.description: The Docker network the cluster's containers join.

apiPort.description: The Kubernetes API's port, on 127.0.0.1 only.

publishAddress.description: The address the web pages are published on: 0.0.0.0 for every address this machine has, or one IPv4 address.

dataRoot.description: The folder that holds everything ok3d keeps. An absolute path with no spaces or quotes.

uid.description: The user ID that owns the data root; ok3d apply sets it to yours. Never 0: nothing of ok3d's keeps data as root.

gid.description: The group ID that owns the data root; ok3d apply sets it to yours. Never 0: nothing of ok3d's keeps data as root.

mode.description: self-issued: ok3d makes its own certificate authority. (Public certificates come in 1.1.)

domain.description: The domain the web pages are named under, such as noc.home.arpa.

caCertificate.description: The certificate authority's public certificate, served at ca.<domain>. ok3d apply fills it in.

modules.description: The parts you can switch on or off. Each is off by default.

plex.description: Plex, watched as a service on your network (0.7).

snmp.description: Switches and NAS that aren't UniFi, through SNMP (0.7).

syslog.description: Syslog from your devices, over UDP and TCP (0.6).

mesh.description: Istio ambient between the cluster's parts (0.8).

remoteAccess.description: Tailscale, to reach ok3d away from home (0.8).

retention.description: How long Prometheus keeps its history, such as 30d or 12w.

retentionSize.description: The most room Prometheus's history may take in the data root, such as 40GB.

unifi.description: The UniFi controller, for modules.unifi. Its API key goes in .env as UNIFI_API_KEY.

url.description: The controller's address, such as https://192.168.1.1. Empty while modules.unifi is off.

verifyTls.description: Whether to check the controller's certificate. Most have a self-signed one, so false.

devices.description: The devices ok3d watches, from devices.yaml.

name.description: What you call it: lowercase letters, digits, and dashes. Shown on the board and in alerts.

address.description: Its IPv4 address or host name. Not a name inside the cluster (.svc, .cluster.local), localhost, or a loopback, link-local, or 0.x address: ok3d watches your network, not itself.

role.description: What kind of device it is.

behind.description: The device it connects through, by name, so a failed one is one alert, not one for every device behind it.

checks.description: What to check: ping, http, https, or tcp:<port>.

metrics.description: Ports where it serves Prometheus metrics, such as 9100 for node_exporter, or 9100/metrics with a path.

protected.description: True means no action may ever touch it, even with your approval.

kube-prometheus-stack.description: How ok3d sets up the kube-prometheus-stack chart. Not a setting of yours.

prometheus-blackbox-exporter.description: How ok3d sets up the prometheus-blackbox-exporter chart. Not a setting of yours.

alerts.description: Where alerts go. The secrets each needs go in .env.

ntfy.description: Alerts on your phone through ntfy. The topic goes in .env as NTFY_TOPIC.

server.description: The ntfy server, such as https://ntfy.sh.

useToken.description: true if the topic needs a login; its token goes in .env as NTFY_TOKEN.

email.description: Alerts by email. The mailbox's password goes in .env as SMTP_PASSWORD.

smarthost.description: The mail server for sending, with its port, such as smtp.example.com:587.

username.description: The mailbox's user name for sending.

requireTls.description: Refuse to send without TLS. Leave it on.

deadman.description: A dead man's switch that hears from ok3d every minute. Its address goes in .env as DEADMAN_URL.

enabled.description: Ping the dead man's switch every minute.

repeatCritical.description: How often a critical alert that's still firing is sent again, such as 1h.

repeatWarning.description: How often a warning that's still firing is sent again, such as 12h.

gateway.description: How ok3d sets up its gateway. Not a setting of yours.
